info.title: Golemio API
info.description:
Toto je dokumentace REST API projektu pražské datové platformy Golemio.

Veškeré dotazy prosím směřujte na golemio@operatorict.cz.

Dokumentace je v anglickém jazyce. Více informací o projektu naleznete na www.golemio.cz.

Description

This documentation covers the RESTful API of the Golemio Prague Data Platform project, specifically detailing the Output Gateway API.

Support is accessible via golemio@operatorict.cz.

For more information about Golemio, please visit the website www.golemio.cz.

Golemio API documentation:

  • 👉 Main Golemio API
  • Open Data Golemio API
  • Golemio Input Gateway API
  • Public Transport Golemio API
  • Public Transport Golemio Input Gateway API

    • General info

    Authorization

    Generate your token at api.golemio.cz/api-keys.

    Use the token as the value of the X-Access-Token header.

    Usage

    Pagination

    The API returns a maximum of 10,000 objects/rows per request. You can specify a lower number by adding the ?limit URL parameter.

    This limit may vary depending on the specific route; please refer to the description of parameters for each route. To retrieve more data, use multiple requests with the ?limit&offset parameters. Refer to the examples below.

    Requests rate

    By default, each API key has a rate limit of 20 requests per 8 seconds.

    Compression

    By default, the Content-Encoding header is set to gzip (if requested). If the raw response is less than 1 KB, the data is returned uncompressed, and the Content-Encoding header is not set.

    Open Data

    This badge indicates that the data is available for public use as Open Data.

get.summary: Search buildings by name, address, GID, EAN, EIC or OM identifier
get.description:
Suggestion endpoint for the DeD map. A single free-text query `q` is matched against the building name, its addresses, the GID and the identifiers of every consumption point mapped to the building.
Matching runs in two tiers. An exact match on an EAN, EIC, OM identifier or GID is returned on its own — fuzzy candidates are dropped entirely and `matched_exactly` is `true`. Note that one identifier can be mapped to several buildings, so an exact match may still return more than one result; the map should zoom automatically only when exactly one result is returned. Otherwise results are ranked by a weighted full-text and trigram score over the name (highest weight), the main address, the secondary addresses and the identifiers. Queries typed without Czech diacritics match normally.
Every result carries the building outline as GeoJSON together with its bounding box and centroid, all in WGS84 (EPSG:4326), so the map can zoom to a hit. They are `null` when the building has no usable geometry, signalled by `geometry_source: null`.

parameters.description: Search text — name, address, GID, EAN, EIC or OM identifier.

parameters.name: limit

get.summary: Get a list of parking locations within the region of interest with filtering options

parameters.name: primarySource
parameters.description: Filter by data source (note that `osm` is a secondary source, not a primary source). Use with square brackets `primarySource[]`. When no filter is used, all parking locations from all primary sources are included along with non-overlapping parking locations from all secondary sources (`osm`). Similarly, when a filter with both primary and secondary sources is used, all parking locations from the specified primary sources are included along with non-overlapping parking locations from the specified secondary sources. When a filter with only a single source is used, all parking locations from the specified source are included regardless of whether the source is primary or secondary.

parameters.name: boundingBox
parameters.description: Filter by bounding box in format "topLeft.lat,topLeft.lon,bottomRight.lat,bottomRight.lon", polygons that fit only partially to selected bounding box are included

matched_exactly.description: True when the query resolved to an exact EAN, EIC, OM identifier or GID. In that case the results contain only exact matches.

registration_unit.description: Evidenční jednotka (eno_ciselnik_evidencni_jednotka) resolved through eno_majetek; null when the building has no majetek record. Its name is part of the search vector.

department.description: Odbor spravující budovu: hlavní evidenční jednotka registrační jednotky (kod_maj_evidencni_jednotka_hl), nebo registrační jednotka samotná, pokud žádnou hlavní jednotku nemá.

addresses.description: Every distinct address of the building, the main one first.

matched_value.description: The identifier that matched. Null for non-exact matches.

score.description: Relevance score. Exact matches always score 1000.

geometry.description: Building outline as GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

bbox.description: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] in WGS84, for zooming the map.

geometry_source.description: Source of the geometry, null when the building has none.

has_building_record.description: False when the GID is known only through the consumption-point mapping or Porsenna and has no eno_budova record. Such results are ranked below described buildings.

EnergeticsEnoRegistrationUnit.description: Evidenční jednotka (eno_ciselnik_evidencni_jednotka) resolved through the building's eno_majetek record. The same shape is returned by the search and the detail endpoint. Null when the building has no majetek record.

name.description: Display name of the building: `building.nazev`, then the Porsenna building name, then null. `building` is null for a substantial share of GIDs and the card still has to render a header, so the fallback is resolved here — the same chain the search endpoint uses — rather than in every client, where the versions would disagree.

address.description: Main address of the building: the first described `addresses[]` entry (they are ordered main-address first), then the Porsenna address, then null.

building.description: All available eno_budova attributes (Czech identifiers mirror the upstream ENO source). Null when the GID has no ENO building record and is known only through the consumption-point mapping. Every property below is always present when the object is; `additionalProperties` stays open so an upstream ENO addition is not breaking.

zdroj.description: ENO source system the row was read from (mhmp / stat).

druh_vytapeni.description: Heating type as recorded in ENO.

property.description: ENO lookup data (eno_ciselnik_*) resolved through the building's eno_majetek record. Null when the building has no majetek record.

department.description: Odbor spravující budovu: hlavní evidenční jednotka registrační jednotky (kod_maj_evidencni_jednotka_hl), nebo registrační jednotka samotná, pokud žádnou hlavní jednotku nemá (tedy pokud je sama odborem).

managers.description: Správci (eno_ciselnik_spravce) from the mandate and accounting-unit references.

energy_management.description: Porsenna (e-manazer) tracking summary; null when the building is not tracked there

data_to.description: Most recent date any of this building's Porsenna devices reported; null when none of them has consumption. Porsenna aggregates carry a covered-day count rather than a reading timestamp, so this is the period start plus its covered days, clamped to the end of the period. A meter count without an as-of date is a claim with no expiry.

EnergeticsEnoHeatSources.description: Heat sources (boiler rooms) recorded for the building.

count.description: Number of heat sources recorded for this building.

total_rated_output_kw.description: Sum of `rated_output_kw` over the building's heat sources

sources.description: The individual appliances, strongest rated output first. .

appliance_name.description: Free-text appliance name from the snapshot.

note.description: Note from the snapshot, e.g. where the figure came from.

rated_output_kw.description: Rated output in kW. `0` means the snapshot states no output

is_monitored.description: Monitoring flag from the source system. Its exact meaning in the source is not documented in the snapshot.

appliance_type.description: Appliance type from the source system. Every row of the current snapshot is `boiler`.

operating_since.description: Date the appliance has been in operation since.

EnergeticsEnoConsumptionEntry.description: One period of one series. `value: null` means the source has no data for that period - missing periods are always null, never an error and never a zero.

period.description: `YYYY-MM` for monthly entries, `YYYY` for yearly ones.

value_kwh.description: Comparable energy. For gas this is derived (normometers_nm3 * combustion_heat) and is null whenever the conversion inputs are missing;

coverage_count.description: Days of the period carrying data.

expected_count.description: Days in the period, so a partial period is recognisable as one.

is_estimated.description: True when the value was allocated pro rata from a billing period spanning more than one month, rather than read for the period itself.

points_total.description: Consumption points that contributed this period at all. `0` for a period no point reported — never null, so a gap is a number a client can compare.

points_with_data.description: Of those, how many carried a value. A shortfall against the series' `points` is how a client learns a building summary is missing an OM for this period rather than being genuinely lower — at point grain the counts are 1/1 or 0/0.

invoice_ids.description: Billing documents this period was allocated from, sorted. Empty for metered readings, for Porsenna and for periods with no value. An allocated month is a number the platform computed rather than one anyone read, so naming the invoice is what makes it auditable. At building level a period can be allocated from several invoices (one per point), and a yearly entry usually is; at point grain a month is normally one.

EnergeticsEnoConsumptionSeries.description: One source's view of one commodity, for one unit.

unit.description: Electricity is kWh. Metered gas is m3 (from the PPAS operating difference) or Nm3 where only the converted difference exists - a point whose unit changes mid-window appears as two series with complementary gaps, which is why unit is part of the key. Porsenna carries its own lowercase unit. Energy Broker is kWh only, full calendar months only, and left out where a live source read the whole month in kWh.

is_metered.description: False for invoiced (billed and allocated) figures, true for meter readings.

points.description: Consumption points contributing to this series.

data_from.description: Earliest period this series has any value for; null when it has none.

monthly.description: `months` entries, chronological, null-filled where the source has nothing. Empty when the source reports only yearly aggregates (Porsenna) - its data is in `yearly`.

yearly.description: One entry per calendar year the window touches, plus any earlier year that has data - Porsenna reaches back further than any monthly source and is not truncated to the months window.

EnergeticsEnoConsumptionHistory.description: Consumption per commodity per source. An empty array for a commodity means no source knows this building at all, which is distinct from a series of nulls - that means the source knows the point but not those periods.

measurement_data_from.description: Earliest month (`YYYY-MM`) with data from a metered source; null when no metered source has monthly data. Explains the leading nulls - meter data starts in 2025 platform-wide. A yearly-only series does not count; its reach-back stays visible in the series' own `data_from`.

has_shared_points.description: True when a contributing consumption point is also mapped to another building. The totals still count such a point in full - that is what its meters measured - so this flag is how a client learns the figure is not exclusive to this building. It is true for both sides of a shared point, primary or not; the points' `shared_with` says which buildings those are.

combined.description: One continuous kWh series per commodity across all sources. Heat and water are out of scope.

sources.description: Sources the period's value was picked from (one per point), sorted and deduplicated. `points_total` counts every point of the series.

EnergeticsEnoCombinedConsumptionSeries.description: Per point and month one kWh source - a whole-month live source, else Energy Broker, else a partial or pro-rata figure - summed across points. Null when no source has kWh.

yearly.description: Sum of the picked months inside the window.

EnergeticsEnoPorsennaBlock.description: Porsenna (e-manazer) device detail with sub-meters. The device's consumption is in the point's `consumption_history` as the `porsenna` series.

EnergeticsEnoElectricityMetadata.description: Latest available month of PRE metadata for the EAN, i.e. the technical parameters of the delivery point as PRE last reported them. Null when PRE has never reported it. Every property is always present; `additionalProperties` stays open so an upstream PRE addition is not breaking.

year.description: Year and month of the metadata row these values come from.

meter_replaced.description: Meter number, or a pipe-separated `date|old|new` triple for the month the meter was replaced. Free text as PRE supplies it, not a parsed structure.

EnergeticsEnoGasInvoice.description: PPAS invoice header. The distribution and commercial invoices carry the same properties; only their sources differ.

preceding_id.description: The invoice this one supersedes, when the two are linked upstream.

is_canceled.description: Always false here — canceled invoices are not served.

EnergeticsEnoGasInstallation.description: The installation (odběrné místo) the invoice bills, as recorded on it. The PPAS-internal place id is deliberately not exposed; it only scopes `devices` and `prices` server-side.

tdd_class.description: Type-day-diagram class used for the allocation of unmetered consumption.

EnergeticsEnoGasInvoiceDevice.description: One billed meter period of the invoice. `kind` is a SAP code and the same gas can appear under several of them in different dimensions, so these rows are the billing detail, not a series to sum — the summed and month-allocated figures are in `consumption_history`.

kind.description: SAP code of the billed quantity (ZIZWC, ZIABN3, …).

consumption.description: Denominated by `unit`, which is not always m³.

combustion_heat.description: kWh/m³; 0 means "not supplied" rather than zero.

EnergeticsEnoGasInvoicePrice.description: One priced line of the invoice for this installation.

is_first_gid.description: Whether this building is the primary holder of the point in the mapping. It says nothing about the other side — see `shared_with`, which lists the buildings the point is shared with whether this one is primary or not.

shared_with.description: Other buildings the same consumption point is mapped to. Empty when the point belongs to this building alone, which is the common case. The totals still count the point in full — that is what its meters measured — so this is how a client learns the figure is not exclusive to this building, and which building it is shared with.

name.description: Resolved as the detail's top-level `name` is; null when neither source names it.

is_active.description: Derived from valid_to (null or in the future means the mapping is active)

address.description: Consumption point address from the best available source

electricity.description: Electricity-specific data (present only for commodity = electricity, omitted otherwise)

metadata.description: Latest available month of PRE metadata for the EAN; null when PRE has never reported it.

consumption_history.description: Per-source series for this point; empty when no source knows it.

gas.description: Gas-specific data (present only for commodity = gas, omitted otherwise)

consumption_history.description: Per-source series for this point; empty when no source knows it.

distribution.description: Latest non-canceled PPAS distribution invoice for this EIC with its installation, billed meter periods and priced lines. Devices and prices are scoped to this point's installation, so another installation on the same invoice does not leak in. Null when no distribution invoice knows the point.

commercial.description: Latest non-canceled PPAS commercial invoice for this EIC, in the same shape as `distribution`. Null when no commercial invoice knows the point.

heat.description: Heat-specific data (present only for commodity = heat, omitted otherwise; Porsenna-sourced)

consumption_history.description: Per-source series for this point; empty when no source knows it.

water.description: Water-specific data (present only for commodity = water, omitted otherwise; Porsenna-sourced)

consumption_history.description: Per-source series for this point; empty when no source knows it.
